description: This is a PHP class file defining the `Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Integer` class, which represents an XML-RPC integer value within the Zend Framework's XML-RPC package. The class extends `Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar` and provides functionality to set, validate, and retrieve integer values for XML-RPC serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Integer
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC integer value, ensuring the value is within the acceptable range and providing methods to retrieve it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a given integer value, throws exception if the value exceeds PHP's integer size.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored integer value contained in the object.
